# Real boxing workout. Disguised as a game.

Play **five** fast-paced boxing minigames in Mixed Reality — plus multiplayer.  

Real combos, real dodging, real sweat — no complicated setup. Just punch and go.

🆕 Latest Update: Rhythm Content Drop


[media]
# PUNCH PADS!
Throw real combos — jabs, crosses, hooks, uppercuts, slips, and ducks. Classic pad work, just like real boxers train.


[media]
#  DUCK OR DIE
Dodge bombs. Smash spheres. Survive as long as you can as the speed keeps climbing.


[media]
#  PUNCHPADS RHYTHM
Hit pads to the beat. Five tracks, three difficulty levels. Nail your timing and chase a perfect score.

[media]
# DUCK STREAM
Dodge everything. Train your head movement, slips, and ducks. No punching — pure defensive skill.

[media]
# BOXBALL VR (Multiplayer)
Punch the ball at everyone in the arena. They punch it back — or they're knocked out. Fast, loud, and competitive.


#  THE 7‑DAY DUCKERS CHALLENGE
 Survive for **1 minutes** in any minigame for **7 days straight** to forge the exclusive **Duckers Gloves**.

# FEATURES:
1. Five minigames
2. Monthly leaderboards & Hall of Fame
3. Mixed Reality — play in your own space
4. Works great on Quest 2, Quest 3, and Quest 3S
5. No complicated setup. No loading screens. Just punch and go.

[media]
#  UPGRADE TO SUPPORTER or PRO STATUS

Free to play with **three** full minigames. Upgrade to Supporter or PRO to unlock all modes, training tools, and exclusive gloves.

Write a review if you like the game!

https://boxing-minigames.com/discord
